description: This file contains the 'RenameModules' class which manages the renaming of modules and related labels, strings, subpanels, and dashlets within the SuiteCRM application. It handles retrieving, modifying, and saving language strings, related links, subpanels, dashlets, and app list strings during the module renaming process.

classes.name: RenameModules
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the renaming of modules, labels, subpanels, dashlets, and related strings within SuiteCRM during module rename operations.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process the renaming operation based on options, such as saving or displaying the interface.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the user interface for renaming modules, including dropdowns and buttons.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Executes the renaming process, updating language strings, related links, subpanels, dashlets, and cache.

methods.name: renameAllSubpanels
methods.description: Renames all subpanels associated with the modules being renamed.

methods.name: renameModuleSubpanel
methods.description: Renames subpanel titles for a specific module.

methods.name: getSubpanelDefs
methods.description: Retrieves subpanel definitions for a given module's bean.

methods.name: renameAllRelatedLinks
methods.description: Renames related links for all modules.

methods.name: renameModuleRelatedLinks
methods.description: Renames related link labels and strings within a module.

methods.name: clearLanguageCaches
methods.description: Clears language cache files and JS language files.

methods.name: renameAllDashlets
methods.description: Renames dashlet titles for modules being renamed.

methods.name: changeModuleDashletStrings
methods.description: Updates dashlet titles for a specific module.

methods.name: changeAllModuleModStrings
methods.description: Iterates over changed modules to update their language strings.

methods.name: renameCertainModuleModStrings
methods.description: Renames specific module strings for a particular module.

methods.name: changeCertainModuleModStrings
methods.description: Replaces relevant labels within a target module for renaming.

methods.name: formatModuleLanguageKey
methods.description: Creates formatted language keys for module labels with placeholders.

methods.name: replaceSingleLabel
methods.description: Replaces a specific label string using provided metadata (singular/plural).

methods.name: changeAppStringEntries
methods.description: Updates dropdowns and list strings to reflect renamed modules.

methods.name: createModuleListSingularPackage
methods.description: Prepares data package for saving module list dropdowns.

methods.name: getChangedModules
methods.description: Determines which modules have been renamed based on user input.

methods.name: getModuleSingularKey
methods.description: Retrieves the singular key name for a module.
